_comment: Used by lib/scorer.js to decide which resume to use for a job. Pass 1 is a title keyword match. Pass 2 cross-checks with skill-keyword overlap; if they disagree, the job is flagged for manual review instead of a silent guess. All three point at the same CV for now: make a tailored PDF per role later and change resumeFile.
notes: fullstack_engineer is the default/primary resume. Edit the keyword lists any time to improve matching as you see real results.
